profile.lead: I am interested in advanced AI systems, AI infrastructure, and agent systems, drawing on my background in building reliable, efficient networked and distributed systems.
bio: I am a Ph.D. student in the School of Informatics at Xiamen University, advised by Professor Qiao Xiang. I also receive research guidance from Qiang Su. I have published at top-tier conferences such as ACM SIGCOMM. My research focuses on network verification, AI infrastructure, and constraint-solving algorithms.

Internships on SuperPod communication modeling and system simulation at Huawei's 2012 Network Technology Lab and development for an A/B testing platform at Tencent shaped my interest in the interconnects, simulation tools, and runtime systems supporting modern AI workloads.

news.text: Began Ph.D. studies in the School of Informatics at Xiamen University, advised by Professor Qiao Xiang.
Our paper Procurator on verifying distributed in-network computing programs was published at ACM SIGCOMM 2026.
Completed the M.S. in Computer Technology at Xiamen University.
Our paper LEOPARD on cloud access-control policy verification was published at IEEE/ACM IWQoS 2025.

research.intro: My research connects formal verification and cross-layer system simulation with open design questions in AI infrastructure and multi-agent runtimes.

areas.title: AI systems & infrastructure
areas.body: How do cluster interconnects, memory hierarchies, and runtime schedulers shape distributed training and inference efficiency? Building on SuperPod communication modeling, I am interested in how transport protocols, collective primitives, and resource multiplexing behave under dynamic AI workloads.

areas.title: Agent systems
areas.body: Multi-step tool invocation, external state mutation, and asynchronous message passing make multi-agent workflows difficult to coordinate and debug. I am interested in how execution tracing, state isolation, and formal verification methods can make agent runtimes predictable and verifiable.

areas.title: Programmable networks & verification
areas.body: My published research builds verification and hardware-acceleration mechanisms for networked and cloud systems. Using reactive actor modeling, intermediate-representation pruning, logical encoding reduction, and programmable switch pipelines, these systems verify distributed P4 programs, check cloud access-control policies, and accelerate SAT search.

project.title: Simulation of Emerging Interconnect Architectures
project.body: This practice involves event-driven simulation of emerging interconnect architectures, modeling cross-layer protocol behavior and communication patterns to examine end-to-end data movement across distributed AI systems.

simulation.heading: Efficient, Scalable, and Accurate AI Infrastructure Simulation
simulation.intro: Building on practical experience in network and communication simulation, I am interested in developing efficient, scalable, and accurate simulation methodologies to analyze the system behavior of modern AI infrastructure.

publications.title: Towards Efficient Verification of Distributed In-Network Computing Programs
publications.summary: Procurator verifies distributed in-network P4 programs by modeling programmable switch pipelines as reactive actors communicating via message passing, combining intermediate-representation pruning and schedule replay to reduce state-space exploration.
publications.booktitle: Proceedings of the ACM SIGCOMM 2026 Conference

publications.title: LEOPARD: Accelerating Cloud-based Access Control Policy Verification Using Logical Encoding Optimization
publications.summary: LEOPARD accelerates SMT-based verification of cloud access-control policies through logical encoding optimization, applying structure-based and semantics-based pruning to remove redundant formulas unrelated to the target verification property.
publications.booktitle: 2025 IEEE/ACM 33rd International Symposium on Quality of Service (IWQoS)

publications.title: Accelerating SAT Solving Using Switching ASICs
publications.summary: This work offloads Boolean satisfiability solving onto programmable switching ASICs, using match-action tables and TCAM to check variable assignments while driving search through data-plane registers and packet mirroring.
publications.booktitle: 2023 IEEE 29th International Conference on Parallel and Distributed Systems (ICPADS)

projects.name: Procurator
projects.description: Open-source verifier for distributed stateful P4 systems. Compiles declarative network specifications and imported P4 programs into Boogie harnesses, then invokes Ultimate/GemCutter to check bounded safety properties and emit counterexample witnesses.

projects.name: Feature Development Skill
projects.description: Portable multi-agent orchestration workflow for software feature delivery. Coordinates parallel work packages through explicit interface contracts, non-overlapping file ownership, single-integrator staging, consolidated feature review, and real-boundary runtime verification.

projects.name: VeriGMP
projects.description: Experimental Rust library for allocation-free multiprecision multiplication, squaring, and modular slice arithmetic. Proves functional refinement in Verus across schoolbook, Karatsuba, Toom-3, and low-product kernels, alongside packed-convolution composition theorems.
